The '''Advanced Development Laboratories''' was a scientific research division in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that was active during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]] held the position of Chief Designer within the division until the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3653 BBY]], when Godera resigned his post in protest of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] that ended the Great Galactic War.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Advanced Development Laboratories was first mentioned in the entry for Doctor Godera in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', a [[2012]] reference guide for the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
